title: Castlegar man confirmed dead after Taser-related incident in Calgary
article: Castlegar resident Gordon Walker Bowe, 30, has died following a Taser related incident in Calgary.

A media release issued by Clif Purvis, Executive Director of the Alberta Serious Incident Response Team stated Calgary police responded to a report of a suspicious person in the area of 507 42 Street S.E. at about 8:15 p.m. on Nov. 1.

"While at the scene, members became aware of a break and enter in progress. One suspect was found hiding in an unoccupied residence in the area. The individual refused to comply with police and while trying to arrest the man a significant physical struggle ensued," read the release.

Police used a conducted energy device (taser), but the release stated it is unclear at this time whether deployment of the taser was successful. The man was arrested, following his arrest the man went into medical distress and was transported to a Calgary hospital. The man died in hospital on November 2.
"The investigation is ongoing and we have the full cooperation of the Calgary Police Service. The medical examiners' office is expected to conduct an autopsy on November 4, 2008," read the release.
